g.text: The checkout flow: Order reserves stock in Inventory with a synchronous REST call before payment (ADR-0005), the customer pays through Stripe, and the order is marked as paid when Stripe's webhook arrives (ADR-0004).

g.data-qualified-name: Webshop.n.size.16..Software System...size..Webshop Monolith.n.size.16..Container. Java. Spring Boot...size.

g.text: 1: Reviews the cart and clicks Pay
3: Reserves stock for the order lines (synchronous REST call; checkout waits for the answer)
4: Requests payment for the order total
5: Creates a payment intent (its client secret goes back to the Web Application)
6: Confirms the payment with the card details
